Sheikh Dr. Salah Al-Budair, the imam of Al-Masjid an-Nabawi: Visit the poor, support the weak, and alleviate from them the scorching heat of summer.

Imam of Al-Masjid an-Nabawi, Sheikh Dr. Salah Al-Budair: Awaken to what lies before you and prepare for the Hereafter, for the successful one is he who benefits from the reminder.
